correctness.rationale: On the affine p156 chart, independent exact symbolic computation verifies all 20 Plucker minors, extraction of four free variables and the block-preserving shear. The projected chart is exactly affine 4-space times the prime rank-one 2x4 determinantal ring, by dense parametrization and kernel equality. The cone has singular locus only its vertex, Hilbert series (1+3t)/(1-t)^5 and multiplicity four. Block-group transitivity covers every point of the Segre fourfold; the blow-up and Plucker-quadratic inverse argument exclude remaining singularities. The same blow-up intersection formula and the hook-length degree 42 yield 41. Normality and Cohen–Macaulayness follow from standard determinantal theory. The verifier confirms polynomial identities and arithmetic, not the global geometric steps.

value.rationale: The degree-two truncation of Gr(3,6) is the first nontrivial intermediate member of a naturally defined modern family. A complete singular locus and uniform Zariski-local normal slice is a structural invariant not determined by its dimension, representation-theoretic homogeneous coordinate dimensions or the abstract existence of blow-ups. It supplies an intrinsic multiplicity and a concrete starting point for further resolution and intersection-theoretic computations; the general determinantal facts are classical, but their identification for this exact object is substantive.
